title: Welcome to CAA Tracker
intro: This app uses official USCIS data to explain how Cuban Adjustment Act green card applications (I-485) are moving, and what could happen with your case.
step1.title: First, choose your language
step1.hint: You can change it any time with the ES | EN button at the top, or in More → Settings.
step2.title: Before you start
card.device: Your data stays on your phone. We never ask for your name or your full receipt number.
card.device.web: Your data stays in this browser. It is not sent to anyone, and we never ask for your name or your full receipt number.
storageNote: If your browser does not allow saving data, this welcome will appear again next time.
